ABOUT

/About the company

Jim's Mowing franchisees help homeowners and businesses across Canada with weekly mowing, garden maintenance, fertilizing, hedge trimming, pruning, gutter cleaning, seasonal cleanups and winter snow and ice control.

Each franchise is independently owned and operated by someone who lives and works in the community. Every job is backed by the training and standards of the wider Jim's Group.

I worked for Jim's Mowing BC, the British Columbia network, which is part of the Ultrabrands Company group.

SCOPE

/My role & scope

For 14 months I worked full-time and remotely as the brand's marketer and virtual assistant. I handled content, SEO, Google Business Profiles, email, design, video, the website, and the customer inquiries that turned into franchisee leads.

  • Planned and published daily Facebook and Instagram posts, scheduled in Zoho Social
  • Ran three recurring series: Monday Memes, Did You Know? and Tip of the Week
  • Made each series in two versions, one for Jim's Mowing and one for GetBCMowing
  • Wrote 80+ industry articles and the service-page content on jimsmowing.ca
  • Drafted with ChatGPT, then edited each article to the brand voice
  • Shared the articles on social media, Google Business Profiles and the newsletter
  • Posted blog articles and graphics to Google Business Profiles
  • Audited the profiles so each one was fully optimized
  • Kept business details the same across every platform
  • Wrote, designed and sent the monthly franchisee newsletter in Mailchimp
  • Each issue covered seasonal how-tos, a "Room for Improvement" note, birthdays and "Jimiversaries", events and the Google Rockstar winner
  • Turned blog content into newsletter features
  • Designed social graphics in Canva and Adobe Photoshop
  • Created AI illustrations with ChatGPT, Gemini and other AI image tools
  • Edited 26 franchise recruitment and franchisee story videos in Adobe Premiere Pro and published them on YouTube
  • Answered inbound customer calls and inquiries
  • Sent each lead to the franchisee nearest the customer
  • Logged and tracked leads in Salesforce and Zoho CRM
  • Made general website updates in WordPress
  • Provided everyday virtual assistance to keep operations running
